feature: Recover 2048 tile movement and scoring from a compiled open-source game

interface.slide(row): Return {row: four tiles, score_delta: int, moved: bool}. Move left with no random spawn.
interface.move(board,direction): Return {board: 4x4 row-major tiles, score_delta: int, moved: bool}. direction is left/right/up/down. No random spawn.

validation.tiles: Exact integers only: zero or powers of two from 2 through 2**20. Reject booleans, floats, negatives, nonpowers, out-of-range.
validation.shape: row is list of length four; board is list of four rows. Inputs remain unchanged.

acceptance: Faithful merge ordering and score increments matched against pinned native functions
Random boards in all directions, fresh seed separate from implementation
Generated module must not import ctypes, subprocess, network or native library; pure Python standard library
Original binary and source used only as independent reference; browser calls recovered module
scope_excluded: Proof of superiority over another model
